name: 会话归档
author: FlameFires
description: 左栏会话行内的归档图标：把对话从侧边栏收起来，不删文件、不申请目录授权；可设 1/7/30 天或永不到期，到期默认只提醒，手动确认才删。附管理面板，支持恢复（自动展开定位并闪烁）与最近删除记录。
descriptionEn: An archive icon in each sidebar conversation row: hide a chat without deleting files or requesting directory access. Optional 1/7/30-day or never expiry; expiry only reminds, deletion needs confirmation. Ships a panel to restore (auto-expand, scroll, flash) and review deleted chats.
